title: Other user profiles on this PC
whyItMatters: Other local accounts have their own folders under C:\Users. The machine may hold data belonging to people other than the person handing it over.
source: SPEC.md platform roots: USERS = C:\Users; other profiles are reported by directory name only (path jail rule 6)
notes: Names only. excludeHome drops the current account; no recursion into any profile, and no junction or symlink is followed.

cleanup.exportFirst: Ask each person to copy their own files out first; removing the account deletes the profile folder.
steps: Read the profile names the plan lists and find out who each one belongs to.
Ask the owner of an account to take their files before you touch it.
For an account that is finished, open Settings > Accounts > Other users, select it and choose Remove.
cleanup.risk: Removing an account deletes that person's profile folder with their files, settings and sign-in. It cannot be undone, and their Microsoft account is untouched.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, Manage User Accounts in Windows: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/security/identity-signin/manage-user-accounts-in-windows
